data.name: Sailen
data.gender_notes: Sailen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over the sea, a form of Lord Vishnu. The name Sailen carries the meaning “Lord of the Sea” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Sailen usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and protection of the sea, and the journey towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Sailen belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Sea.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sailen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

He is known to have led victorious battles against the Sultanate of Delhi and played a crucial role in the expansion of the Eastern Gangas' territory in Odisha, India.
